notes.title: Leave Early Access
notes.notes:
Hello to all our players. We decided to leave early access, but this does not mean that work on the game will be completed,
Only the early access label will disappear. But we will continue to work on the game and there will be a full release in the future.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33569496/6b3e14707e10ee5b6499225a949ddadb2708dac4.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33569496/b1e30e188df7876e34c37c9de0f555ac3821da1f.png[/img][/url]

1. The translation is improved: all words that weren't translated are now translated.
2. The accuracy of riflemen and cannons is improved.
3. The build for x86 architecture is added.
4. The optimization is improved.
5. Added: use 'ESC' to open the pause menu that stops the game.
6. Added: the background under the menu to make the menu more visible.
7. Added: you can now sell units.
8. Fixed: the bug of hero's random appearance in the center of the map.

notes.title: Optimization Patch
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33569496/ca3962be4472cc7f2c97f02965b3dbf04d128b46.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33569496/ac2ec81034c6c5222b84ad9d3c4183792f019d66.png[/img][/url]

1. The performance of the game is optimized.
2. The bug with the riflemen standing in place is fixed: now they attack the enemy.
3. The display of the number of live units of the enemy is added to the upper left corner.

notes.title: Info
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33569496/39f9dce5abe4fede59bee6098531216bb1be8096.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33569496/67ad0542fe99d11fc9d03b2659ff256a062bc83a.png[/img][/url]

Use key (F) to command units. Language change works one time. To change it several times, you need to restart the game. We haven't supposed that somebody will change the language several times. We'll fix it in a few days.﻿
